## What This Guide Helps With

Troubleshooting an intermittent keypad backlight during a scheduled bench inspection.

## Step-by-Step Troubleshooting

### 1. Remove the Pump From Clinical Use

Disconnect the pump from patient use and apply the facility's inspection controls.

**Expected outcome:** The pump is available for a safe bench inspection.

### 2. Verify the Reported Condition

Power the pump with approved AC power and observe the keypad backlight without opening the enclosure.

**Expected outcome:** The reported backlight condition is confirmed or cannot be reproduced.

## If the Problem Persists

Remove the pump from service and escalate it to personnel authorized by the manufacturer. Complete all required performance and safety testing before return to service.

## Clinical Use Tip

Record whether room lighting or viewing angle affected the report.

## Work Order Documentation (CCR Method)

Use the approved Complaint, Cause, and Resolution entries from the front matter.

Use the reviewed helpful-detail labels from the front matter.

## Final Thought

A repeatable observation and a documented escalation boundary support safe troubleshooting.
